mentions.name: Symmetric Crypto Chat Room
mentions.description: A browser-based encrypted chat room with true end-to-end encryption. Users share a symmetric encryption key with someone offline, then chat with text, voice, video, and file sharing, all encrypted with that key; nothing is shared with the server.
mentions.source_excerpt: Share an encryption key with someone offline, then chat with them (text + voice + video + file) encrypted with that key. Your JavaScript browser only knows that key. Nothing is shared. True end-to-end encryption in your browser.
